  <div class="logo"><span>Xender-lite</span></div>
  <p class="subtitle">Connected via local network</p>

  <div class="card">
    <div class="device-name" id="deviceName">My Computer</div>
    <div class="device-ip" id="deviceIp">192.168.X.X</div>
    <div class="status connect" id="status">Ready to receive files</div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="location.href='./upload'">Send Files</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="location.reload()">Refresh Connection</button>
  </div>

  <div class="files-section" id="filesSection">
    <h3>Shared files</h3>
    <div class="files-card" id="filesList">
      <div class="empty-files" id="emptyFiles">No shared files yet. Allow it in settings (Allow viw no web)</div>
    </div>

  <script src="/socket.io/socket.io.js"></script>
  <script src="script/toast.js"></script>
  <script src="script/setting.js"></script>
  <script>
    const socket = io();
    const deviceNameEl = document.getElementById('deviceName');
    const htmlTitle = document.getElementById('title');
    const deviceIpEl = document.getElementById('deviceIp');
    const accentTag = document.getElementById('accent');
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('status');
    const filesSection = document.getElementById('filesSection');
    const filesList = document.getElementById('filesList');
    const emptyFiles = document.getElementById('emptyFiles');

    let allowFilesView = false;
    /** @type {Map<string, object>} */
    const filesMap = new Map();

    deviceIpEl.innerText = location.hostname;

    function fileId(file) {
      return String(file.id || file.path || file.name);
    }

    function formatSize(bytes) {
      if (bytes == null || bytes === '') return '--';
      const n = Number(bytes);
      if (Number.isNaN(n)) return String(bytes);
      if (n < 1024) return n + ' B';
      if (n < 1024 * 1024) return (n / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
      return (n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
    }

    function iconFor(name) {
      const ext = (name || '').split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
      if (['png','jpg','jpeg','gif','webp','svg'].includes(ext)) return '🖼️';
      if (['mp4','mkv','mov','webm','avi'].includes(ext)) return '🎬';
      if (['mp3','wav','flac','aac','ogg'].includes(ext)) return '🎵';
      if (ext === 'pdf') return '📕';
      if (['zip','rar','7z','tar','gz'].includes(ext)) return '📦';
      return '📄';
    }

    function createFileElement(file) {
      const id = fileId(file);
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'list-item';
      div.dataset.id = id;
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="file-icon"></div>
        <div class="file-info">
          <h4></h4>
          <p></p>
        </div>
        <div class="file-actions">
          <button type="button" data-action="save">Save</button>
        </div>
      `;
      div.querySelector('.file-icon').textContent = iconFor(file.name);
      div.querySelector('h4').textContent = file.name || 'Untitled';
      div.querySelector('p').textContent = formatSize(file.size);
      div.querySelector('[data-action="save"]').addEventListener('click', () => {
        saveFile(file.id || id);
      });
      return div;
    }

    function toggleEmpty() {
      const has = filesList.querySelectorAll('.list-item').length > 0;
      if (emptyFiles) emptyFiles.style.display = has ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    function renderFiles(files) {
      if (!allowFilesView) return;
      filesSection.classList.add('visible');
      filesMap.clear();
      filesList.querySelectorAll('.list-item').forEach((n) => n.remove());
      (files || []).forEach((f) => {
        const id = fileId(f);
        filesMap.set(id, f);
        filesList.appendChild(createFileElement(f));
      });
      toggleEmpty();
    }

    function updateFile(file) {
      if (!allowFilesView || !file) return;
      filesSection.classList.add('visible');
      const id = fileId(file);
      filesMap.set(id, file);
      const existing = filesList.querySelector(`.list-item[data-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);
      const el = createFileElement(file);
      if (existing) existing.replaceWith(el);
      else filesList.appendChild(el);
      toggleEmpty();
    }

    function removeFile(fileOrId) {
      if (!allowFilesView) return;
      const id = typeof fileOrId === 'object' ? fileId(fileOrId) : String(fileOrId);
      filesMap.delete(id);
      const el = filesList.querySelector(`.list-item[data-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);
      if (el) el.remove();
      toggleEmpty();
    }

    function saveFile(id) {
      if (!socket.connected) {
        if (Toast) toast('Not connected', 'error');
        return;
      }
      socket.emit('save-file', { id });
      if (Toast) toast('Saving file…', 'info', 2000);
    }

    function setTheme(newTheme) {
      document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', newTheme);
    }
    function setAccent(accent) {
      const accents = {
        primary: { src: 'style/theme.css', icon: 'icon/logo.png' },
        colored: { src: 'style/theme-color.css', icon: 'icon/logo-color.png' },
        neon: { src: 'style/theme-dark.css', icon: 'icon/logo-dark.png' },
      };
      const found = accents[accent] || accents.primary;
      const iconTag = document.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]');
      if (iconTag) iconTag.href = found.icon;
      if (accentTag && accentTag.href.indexOf(found.src) === -1) {
        accentTag.href = found.src;
      }
    }

    socket.on('connect', () => {
      statusEl.innerText = 'Connected, Ready to send.';
      statusEl.classList.add('connect');
      htmlTitle.innerText = 'Xender-lite Web UI • Connected';
      socket.emit('start-live');
    });

    socket.on('disconnect', () => {
      statusEl.innerText = 'You are disconnected';
      statusEl.classList.remove('connect');
      htmlTitle.innerText = 'Xender-lite Web UI • Disconnected';
      if (Toast) toast('Disconnected', 'warning');
    });

    socket.on('file-changed', (data) => {
      if (data && data.path && /\.(html|css|js)$/i.test(data.path)) {
        location.reload();
        return;
      }
      // treat as file-change for shared list
      handleLanFileChange(data);
    });

    socket.on('allow-files', (rules) => {
      if (rules && rules.allow) {
        allowFilesView = true;
        filesSection.classList.add('visible');
        renderFiles(rules.files || []);
        if (Toast) toast('File sharing enabled on this page', 'success', 2500);
      } else {
        allowFilesView = false;
        filesSection.classList.remove('visible');
        filesMap.clear();
        filesList.querySelectorAll('.list-item').forEach((n) => n.remove());
        toggleEmpty();
      }
    });

    socket.on('save-file', (file) => {
      saveFile(file && (file.id || file));
    });

    socket.on('device-name', (name) => {
      deviceNameEl.textContent = (name && (name.name || name)) || 'Host Device';
    });

    socket.on('device-ip', (ip) => {
      deviceIpEl.innerText = (ip && (ip.ip || ip)) || location.hostname;
    });

    socket.on('theme', setTheme);
    socket.on('accent', setAccent);

    socket.on('update-file', (file) => {
      if (allowFilesView) updateFile(file);
    });

    socket.on('file-added', (file) => {
      if (allowFilesView) updateFile(file);
    });

    socket.on('file-removed', (file) => {
      if (allowFilesView) removeFile(file);
    });

    socket.on('file-deleted', (file) => {
      if (allowFilesView) removeFile(file);
    });

    socket.on('file-change', handleLanFileChange);

    function handleLanFileChange(payload) {
      if (!allowFilesView || !payload) return;
      const action = (payload.action || payload.type || '').toLowerCase();
      const file = payload.file || payload.data || payload;

      if (action === 'delete' || action === 'remove' || action === 'deleted') {
        removeFile(file.id != null ? file.id : file);
        return;
      }
      if (action === 'add' || action === 'added' || action === 'create' || action === 'update' || action === 'updated') {
        updateFile(typeof file === 'object' ? file : { id: file, name: String(file) });
        return;
      }
      if (file && (file.name || file.id)) updateFile(file);
    }

    socket.on('save-result', (res) => {
      if (!res) return;
      if (res.ok || res.success) {
        if (Toast) toast(res.message || 'File saved', 'success');
      } else {
        if (Toast) toast(res.error || res.message || 'Save failed', 'error');
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<body>
  <div class="app">
    <header>
      <h1>Upload Files</h1> 
      <div>
      <a href="/">Files </a>
      <p class="status-pill" id="connectionStatus">Connecting...</p></div>
    </header>

    <!-- Drop Zone -->
    <div class="drop-zone" id="dropZone">
      <div class="icon">📂</div>
      <h3>Drop files here</h3>
      <p>or click to browse • Resumable upload supported</p>
    </div>

    <!-- File List -->
    <div class="file-list" id="fileList">
      <div class="empty" id="emptyState">No files selected yet</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <script src="script/setting.js"></script>

  <script>
    const socket = io();
    const dropZone = document.getElementById('dropZone');
    const fileList = document.getElementById('fileList');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
    const html = document.body;
    const accentTag = document.getElementById('accent')
    const connectionStatus = document.getElementById('connectionStatus');

    // ========== Socket.IO ==========
    socket.on('connect', () => {
      connectionStatus.textContent = 'Connected';
      connectionStatus.style.color = '#22C55E';
      socket.emit('start-live');
      wireThemeSocket(socket);
      socket.on('file-changed', (data) => {
        location.reload();
      });

    });
     

    socket.on('disconnect', () => {
      connectionStatus.textContent = 'Disconnected';
      connectionStatus.style.color = '#EF4444';
    });

    // ========== Resumable.js ==========
    const r = new Resumable({
      target: '/upload-file',           // change to your upload endpoint
      chunkSize: 8 * 1024 * 1024,  // 5 MB chunks
      simultaneousUploads: 3,
      testChunks: true,
      //throttleProgressCallbacks: 1,
      query: { socketId: socket.id }
    });

    r.assignBrowse(dropZone);
    r.assignDrop(dropZone);

    // Drag visual
    dropZone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      dropZone.classList.add('dragover');
    });
    dropZone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
      dropZone.classList.remove('dragover');
    });
    dropZone.addEventListener('drop', () => {
      dropZone.classList.remove('dragover');
    });

    // ========== Helpers ==========
    function formatSize(bytes) {
      if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
      const k = 1024;
      const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
      const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
      return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
    }

    function getFileIcon(filename) {
      const ext = filename.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
      if (['jpg','jpeg','png','gif','webp','svg'].includes(ext)) return '🖼️';
      if (['mp4','mkv','avi','mov'].includes(ext)) return '🎬';
      if (['mp3','wav','flac','aac'].includes(ext)) return '🎵';
      if (['pdf'].includes(ext)) return '📄';
      if (['zip','rar','7z'].includes(ext)) return '📦';
      return '📁';
    }

    // Store UI elements per file
    const fileUI = new Map();

    function createFileCard(file) {
      emptyState.style.display = 'none';

      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'file-card uploading';
      card.dataset.fileId = file.uniqueIdentifier;

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="file-header">
          <div class="file-icon">${getFileIcon(file.fileName)}</div>
          <div class="file-info">
            <h4 title="${file.fileName}""> ${file.fileName}</h4>
            <p>${formatSize(file.size)}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="file-actions">
            <button class="btn-pause" title="Pause">⏸</button>
            <button class="btn-cancel" title="Cancel">✕</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-wrap">
          <div class="progress-bar">
            <div class="progress-fill" style="width:0%"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="progress-meta">
            <span class="percent">0%</span>
            <span class="speed">—</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      fileList.prepend(card);

      const fill = card.querySelector('.progress-fill');
      const percentEl = card.querySelector('.percent');
      const speedEl = card.querySelector('.speed');
      const pauseBtn = card.querySelector('.btn-pause');
      const cancelBtn = card.querySelector('.btn-cancel');

      // Pause / Resume
      pauseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (file.isUploading()) {
          file.abort();
          card.classList.remove('uploading');
          card.classList.add('paused');
          fill.classList.add('paused');
          pauseBtn.textContent = '▶';
          pauseBtn.title = 'Resume';
          socket.emit('upload:paused', { id: file.uniqueIdentifier, name: file.fileName });
        } else {
          file.retry();
          card.classList.remove('paused');
          card.classList.add('uploading');
          fill.classList.remove('paused');
          pauseBtn.textContent = '⏸';
          pauseBtn.title = 'Pause';
          socket.emit('upload:resumed', { id: file.uniqueIdentifier, name: file.fileName });
        }
      });

      // Cancel
      cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        file.cancel();
        card.remove();
        fileUI.delete(file.uniqueIdentifier);
        socket.emit('upload:cancelled', { id: file.uniqueIdentifier, name: file.fileName });
        if (fileUI.size === 0) emptyState.style.display = 'block';
      });

      fileUI.set(file.uniqueIdentifier, { card, fill, percentEl, speedEl, pauseBtn });
    }

    // ========== Resumable Events ==========
    r.on('fileAdded', (file) => {
      createFileCard(file);
      r.upload(); // start automatically
      socket.emit('upload:started', {
        id: file.uniqueIdentifier,
        name: file.fileName,
        size: file.size
      });
    });

    r.on('fileProgress', (file) => {
      const ui = fileUI.get(file.uniqueIdentifier);
      if (!ui) return;

      const progress = Math.floor(file.progress() * 100);
      ui.fill.style.width = progress + '%';
      ui.percentEl.textContent = progress + '%';

      // simple speed estimate
      const speed = file.averageSpeed || 0;
      ui.speedEl.textContent = speed > 0 ? formatSize(speed) + '/s' : '—';

      socket.emit('upload:progress', {
        id: file.uniqueIdentifier,
        name: file.fileName,
        progress,
        speed
      });
    });

    r.on('fileSuccess', (file, message) => {
      const ui = fileUI.get(file.uniqueIdentifier);
      if (!ui) return;

      ui.card.classList.remove('uploading', 'paused');
      ui.card.classList.add('success');
      ui.fill.classList.remove('paused');
      ui.fill.classList.add('success');
      ui.fill.style.width = '100%';
      ui.percentEl.textContent = '100%';
      ui.speedEl.textContent = 'Done';
      ui.pauseBtn.style.display = 'none';

      socket.emit('upload:success', {
        id: file.uniqueIdentifier,
        name: file.fileName
      });
      setTimeout(() =>{
        document.querySelector('.btn-cancel').click()
      }, 2570)
    });

    r.on('fileError', (file, message) => {
      const ui = fileUI.get(file.uniqueIdentifier);
      if (!ui) return;

      ui.card.classList.remove('uploading', 'paused');
      ui.card.classList.add('error');
      ui.fill.classList.remove('paused');
      ui.fill.classList.add('error');
      ui.speedEl.textContent = 'Failed';
      ui.pauseBtn.textContent = '↺';
      ui.pauseBtn.title = 'Retry';

      socket.emit('upload:error', {
        id: file.uniqueIdentifier,
        name: file.fileName,
        error: message
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
--- CONTENT END ---

  <script src="script/toast.js"></script>
  <script src="script/socket/socket.io.min.js"></script>
  <script src="script/setting.js"></script>
  <script>
    /** @type {Map<string, object>} */
    const devicesMap = new Map();
    /** @type {Map<string, object>} */
    const connectedMap = new Map();

    let pendingDevice = null;
    let connecting = false;

    const deviceListEl = document.getElementById('deviceList');
    const connectedListEl = document.getElementById('connectedList');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
    const emptyConnected = document.getElementById('emptyConnected');
    const scanStatus = document.getElementById('scanStatus');
    const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scanBtn');
    const refreshBtn = document.getElementById('refreshBtn');

    const modal = document.getElementById('connectModal');
    const modalSub = document.getElementById('modalSub');
    const passwordInput = document.getElementById('passwordInput');
    const modalError = document.getElementById('modalError');
    const modalCancel = document.getElementById('modalCancel');
    const modalConfirm = document.getElementById('modalConfirm');

    function deviceId(d) {
      return String(d.id || d.ip || d.address || d.ssid || d.name);
    }

    function deviceIcon(d) {
      const t = (d.type || d.kind || '').toLowerCase();
      if (t.includes('phone') || t.includes('mobile') || t.includes('android') || t.includes('ios')) return '<i class="fa fa-mobile"></i>';
      if (t.includes('tablet')) return '<i class="fa fa-tablet"></i>';
      if (t.includes('tv')) return '<i class="fa fa-tv"></i>';
      return '<i class="fa fa-laptop"></i>';
    }

    function createDeviceRow(d, isConnected) {
      const id = deviceId(d);
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'list-item';
      row.dataset.id = id;

      const status = isConnected ? 'connected' : (d.online === false ? 'offline' : '');
      const badgeClass = status === 'connected' ? 'badge connected' : (status === 'offline' ? 'badge offline' : 'badge');
      const badgeText = status === 'connected' ? 'Connected' : (status === 'offline' ? 'Offline' : (d.signal || d.rssi ? 'Nearby' : 'Available'));

      row.innerHTML = `
        <div class="device-icon"></div>
        <div class="device-info">
          <h4></h4>
          <p></p>
        </div>
        <span class="${badgeClass}">${badgeText}</span>
        <button type="button" class="connect-btn ${isConnected ? 'secondary' : ''}"></button>
      `;
      row.querySelector('.device-icon').innerHTML = deviceIcon(d);
      row.querySelector('h4').textContent = d.name || d.hostname || d.ssid ||'Unknown device';
      const ip = d.ip || d.address || '';
      const extra = d.os || d.platform || '';
      row.querySelector('p').textContent = [ip, extra].filter(Boolean).join(' • ') || 'Wi‑Fi device';

      const btn = row.querySelector('.connect-btn');
      if (isConnected) {
        btn.textContent = 'Disconnect';
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => disconnectDevice(d));
      } else {
        btn.textContent = 'Connect';
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => openConnectDialog(d));
      }
      return row;
    }

    function renderNearby() {
      deviceListEl.querySelectorAll('.list-item').forEach((n) => n.remove());
      const list = Array.from(devicesMap.values()).filter((d) => !connectedMap.has(deviceId(d)));
      if (list.length === 0) {
        emptyState.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        emptyState.style.display = 'none';
        list.forEach((d) => deviceListEl.appendChild(createDeviceRow(d, false)));
      }
    }

    function renderConnected() {
      connectedListEl.querySelectorAll('.list-item').forEach((n) => n.remove());
      const list = Array.from(connectedMap.values());
      if (list.length === 0) {
        emptyConnected.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        emptyConnected.style.display = 'none';
        list.forEach((d) => connectedListEl.appendChild(createDeviceRow(d, true)));
      }
    }

    function upsertDevice(d) {
      if (!d) return;
      const id = deviceId(d);
      devicesMap.set(id, { ...devicesMap.get(id), ...d });
      if (d.connected) {
        connectedMap.set(id, devicesMap.get(id));
      }
      renderNearby();
      renderConnected();
    }

    function removeDevice(dOrId) {
      const id = typeof dOrId === 'object' ? deviceId(dOrId) : String(dOrId);
      devicesMap.delete(id);
      connectedMap.delete(id);
      renderNearby();
      renderConnected();
    }

    function openConnectDialog(device) {
      pendingDevice = device;
      modalError.textContent = '';
      passwordInput.value = '';
      modalSub.textContent = `Connect to “${device.name || device.hostname || device.ip || 'device'}”. Enter password if the host requires one.`;
      modal.classList.add('open');
      passwordInput.focus();
    }

    function closeModal() {
      modal.classList.remove('open');
      pendingDevice = null;
      connecting = false;
      modalConfirm.disabled = false;
      modalConfirm.textContent = 'Connect';
    }

    function submitConnect() {
      if (!pendingDevice || connecting) return;
      if (!socket.connected) {
        modalError.textContent = 'Not connected to server. Try again.';
        if (Toast) Toast.error('Server offline');
        return;
      }

      connecting = true;
      modalConfirm.disabled = true;
      modalConfirm.textContent = 'Connecting…';
      modalError.textContent = '';

      const payload = {
        id: pendingDevice.id || deviceId(pendingDevice),
        ip: pendingDevice.ip || pendingDevice.address,
        name: pendingDevice.name,
        password: passwordInput.value || undefined,
      };

      // Timeout safety
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!connecting) return;
        connecting = false;
        modalConfirm.disabled = false;
        modalConfirm.textContent = 'Connect';
        modalError.textContent = 'Connection timed out. Check the password and network.';
        if (Toast) Toast.error('Connection timed out');
      }, 15000);

      socket.emit('connect-device', payload, (ack) => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        // Optional callback-style ack from server
        if (ack) handleConnectResult(ack);
      });

      // Also listen once for result event (servers may not use ack)
      socket.once('connect-device-result', (res) => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        handleConnectResult(res);
      });
    }

    function handleConnectResult(res) {
      connecting = false;
      modalConfirm.disabled = false;
      modalConfirm.textContent = 'Connect';

      if (!res) {
        modalError.textContent = 'No response from server.';
        return;
      }

      if (res.ok || res.success || res.status === 'connected') {
        const dev = res.device || pendingDevice;
        if (dev) {
          const id = deviceId(dev);
          connectedMap.set(id, { ...dev, connected: true });
          devicesMap.set(id, connectedMap.get(id));
        }
        renderNearby();
        renderConnected();
        closeModal();
        if (Toast) {
          Toast.success(res.message || `Connected to ${dev && (dev.name || dev.ip) || 'device'}`);
        }
        return;
      }

      // Error cases
      const code = res.code || res.errorCode || '';
      let msg = res.error || res.message || 'Could not connect';
      if (code === 'WRONG_PASSWORD' || /password/i.test(msg)) {
        msg = 'Incorrect password. Please try again.';
      } else if (code === 'UNREACHABLE' || /unreachable|timeout/i.test(msg)) {
        msg = 'Device unreachable. Are you on the same Wi‑Fi?';
      } else if (code === 'BUSY') {
        msg = 'Device is busy. Try again in a moment.';
      } else if (code === 'REJECTED') {
        msg = 'Connection rejected by the other device.';
      }
      modalError.textContent = msg;
      if (Toast) Toast.error(msg);
    }

    function disconnectDevice(d) {
      if (!socket.connected) {
        if (Toast) Toast.error('Not connected to server',);
        return;
      }
      socket.emit('disconnect-device', {
        id: d.id || d.ssid || deviceId(d),
        ip: d.ip || d.address,
      });
      connectedMap.delete(deviceId(d));
      if (devicesMap.has(deviceId(d))) {
        devicesMap.set(deviceId(d), { ...devicesMap.get(deviceId(d)), connected: false });
      }
      renderNearby();
      renderConnected();
      if (Toast) Toast.info('Disconnected');
    }

    function startScan() {
      if (!socket.connected) {
        scanStatus.textContent = 'Server offline — reconnecting…';
        scanStatus.classList.remove('scanning');
        if (Toast) Toast.error('Not connected to server');
        return;
      }
      scanStatus.textContent = 'Scanning Wi‑Fi for devices…';
      scanStatus.classList.add('scanning');
      socket.emit('scan-wifi-devices');
      socket.emit('get-wifi-devices');
    }

    modalCancel.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    modalConfirm.addEventListener('click', submitConnect);
    passwordInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') submitConnect();
      if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
    });
    modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
    });

    scanBtn.addEventListener('click', startScan);
    refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', startScan);

    // ===== Socket =====
    const socket = io();
    wireThemeSocket(socket);

    socket.on('connect', () => {
      scanStatus.textContent = 'Connected — scanning…';
      scanStatus.classList.add('scanning');
      socket.emit('start-live');
      socket.emit('user-setting');
      socket.emit('scan-wifi-devices');
      socket.emit('get-wifi-devices');
      socket.emit('get-connected-devices');
      console.log('socket connected')
    });

    socket.on('disconnect', () => {
      scanStatus.textContent = 'Disconnected from server';
      scanStatus.classList.remove('scanning');
      if (Toast) Toast.warning('Disconnected from server');
    });

    socket.on('wifi-devices', (data) => {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data && data.devices) || [];
      devicesMap.clear();
      list.forEach((d) => {
        const id = deviceId(d);
        devicesMap.set(id, d);
        if (d.connected) connectedMap.set(id, d);
      });
      renderNearby();
      renderConnected();
      scanStatus.textContent = list.length
        ? `Found ${list.length} device(s)`
        : 'No devices found on this network';
      scanStatus.classList.remove('scanning');
    });

    socket.on('wifi-device', (d) => {
      upsertDevice(d);
      scanStatus.classList.remove('scanning');
    });

    socket.on('device-found', (d) => upsertDevice(d));
    socket.on('device-lost', (d) => removeDevice(d));
    socket.on('device-updated', (d) => upsertDevice(d));

    socket.on('connected-devices', (data) => {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data && data.devices) || [];
      connectedMap.clear();
      list.forEach((d) => connectedMap.set(deviceId(d), { ...d, connected: true }));
      renderConnected();
      renderNearby();
    });

    socket.on('connect-device-result', handleConnectResult);
    socket.on('device-connect-error', (err) => {
      const msg = (err && (err.message || err.error)) || 'Connection failed';
      if (modal.classList.contains('open')) {
        connecting = false;
        modalConfirm.disabled = false;
        modalConfirm.textContent = 'Connect';
        modalError.textContent = msg;
      }
      if (Toast) Toast.error(msg);
    });

    socket.on('scan-error', (err) => {
      const msg = (err && (err.message || err.error)) || 'Scan failed';
      scanStatus.textContent = msg;
      scanStatus.classList.remove('scanning');
      if (Toast) Toast.error(msg);
    });

    socket.on('scan-complete', (data) => {
      scanStatus.classList.remove('scanning');
      const n = (data && data.count) != null ? data.count : devicesMap.size;
      scanStatus.textContent = n ? `Found ${n} device(s)` : 'Scan complete — no devices';
    });
    socket.on('flash', () =>{
      console.log('close app emite')
      xenderNative.flash()
    })
    socket.on('close-app', () =>{
      xenderNative.close()
    })
  </script>
</body>
</html>
--- CONTENT END ---

      socket.on('file-changed', ()=>location.reload())
      socket.on('is-connected', (conn)=>{
      if (conn) {
        isconnected = true
      }
      if (!conn) {
        isconnected = false
      }
    })

    socket.on('disconnect', () => {
      if (Toast) Toast.warning('Disconnected from the main System');
    });

dropZone.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        native.selectFiles({filters: '*'}).then(result => {
          if (result && result.data && result.data.files !== 0) {
            const files = result.data.files;
            if (!isconnected) Toast.warning(`No any connected device, connect and try again.`)
            if (Toast) Toast.info(`Sending ${result.data.files.length} files`);
            files.forEach(file => {
                socket.emit('send-file', file)
                log('sindind', file)
            });
          }
        })
      });
      socket.on('flash', () =>{
      console.log('close app emite')
      xenderNative.flash()
    })
      
    // ===== Socket.IO =====
    wireThemeSocket(socket);
      socket.on('close-app', () =>{
      xenderNative.close()

  <script src="script/toast.js"></script>

  <script src="script/xender-native.js"></script>
  <script>
    const socket = io();
    let a =true
    function switchMode(mode) {
      if (a) {
        console.log(a)
        socket.on('connect', () =>{
          socket.emit('start-server')
        })
        a = false
      }
      const heroWeb = document.getElementById('heroWeb');
      const heroPc = document.getElementById('heroPc');
      const webModeBtn = document.getElementById('webModeBtn');
      const pcModeBtn = document.getElementById('pcModeBtn');
      if (mode === 'web') {
        heroWeb.style.display = 'block';
        heroPc.style.display = 'none';
        webModeBtn.classList.add('active');
        pcModeBtn.classList.remove('active');
      } else if (mode === 'pc') {
        heroWeb.style.display = 'none';
        heroPc.style.display = 'block';
        webModeBtn.classList.remove('active');
        pcModeBtn.classList.add('active');
      }
      if (typeof socket !== 'undefined' && socket.connected) {
        socket.emit('set-mode', { mode });
      }
    }

    // ===== Incoming transfers =====
    /** @type {Map<string, object>} */
    const transfers = new Map();
    const transfersCard = document.getElementById('transfersCard');
    const emptyTransfers = document.getElementById('emptyTransfers');
    const receiveHint = document.getElementById('receiveHint');
    const connStatus = document.getElementById('connStatus');

    function transferId(t) {
      return String(t.id || t.transferId || t.name + '-' + (t.from || ''));
    }

    function formatSize(bytes) {
      if (bytes == null) return '';
      const n = Number(bytes);
      if (Number.isNaN(n)) return String(bytes);
      if (n < 1024) return n + ' B';
      if (n < 1024 * 1024) return (n / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
      return (n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
    }

    function clampPct(p) {
      const n = Number(p);
      if (Number.isNaN(n)) return 0;
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(n)));
    }

    function createTransferEl(t) {
      const id = transferId(t);
      const pct = clampPct(t.progress != null ? t.progress : t.percent);
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'list-item';
      div.dataset.id = id;
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="file-icon">📥</div>
        <div class="file-info">
          <h4></h4>
          <p class="meta"></p>
          <div class="progress-wrap"><div class="progress-bar"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="transfer-pct"></div>
      `;
      div.querySelector('h4').textContent = t.name || t.filename || 'Incoming file';
      const from = t.from || t.device || t.source || '';
      const size = formatSize(t.size || t.total);
      const status = t.status || (pct >= 100 ? 'Done' : 'Receiving');
      div.querySelector('.meta').textContent = [from, size, status].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
      div.querySelector('.progress-bar').style.width = pct + '%';
      div.querySelector('.transfer-pct').textContent = pct + '%';
      return div;
    }

    function upsertTransfer(t) {
      if (!t) return;
      const id = transferId(t);
      const prev = transfers.get(id) || {};
      const merged = { ...prev, ...t, id };
      transfers.set(id, merged);

      emptyTransfers.style.display = 'none';
      let el = transfersCard.querySelector(`.list-item[data-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);
      if (el) {
        const pct = clampPct(merged.progress != null ? merged.progress : merged.percent);
        el.querySelector('h4').textContent = merged.name || merged.filename || 'Incoming file';
        const from = merged.from || merged.device || merged.source || '';
        const size = formatSize(merged.size || merged.total);
        const status = merged.status || (pct >= 100 ? 'Done' : 'Receiving');
        el.querySelector('.meta').textContent = [from, size, status].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
        el.querySelector('.progress-bar').style.width = pct + '%';
        el.querySelector('.transfer-pct').textContent = pct + '%';
      } else {
        transfersCard.appendChild(createTransferEl(merged));
      }

      const active = Array.from(transfers.values()).filter((x) => clampPct(x.progress != null ? x.progress : x.percent) < 100).length;
      receiveHint.textContent = active ? `${active} receiving…` : 'Waiting…';
    }

    function removeTransfer(tOrId) {
      const id = typeof tOrId === 'object' ? transferId(tOrId) : String(tOrId);
      transfers.delete(id);
      const el = transfersCard.querySelector(`.list-item[data-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);
      if (el) el.remove();
      if (transfers.size === 0) emptyTransfers.style.display = 'block';
      const active = Array.from(transfers.values()).filter((x) => clampPct(x.progress != null ? x.progress : x.percent) < 100).length;
      receiveHint.textContent = active ? `${active} receiving…` : 'Waiting…';
    }

    function renderTransfers(list) {
      transfers.clear();
      transfersCard.querySelectorAll('.list-item').forEach((n) => n.remove());
      (list || []).forEach((t) => {
        transfers.set(transferId(t), t);
        transfersCard.appendChild(createTransferEl(t));
      });
      emptyTransfers.style.display = transfers.size === 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    // ===== Socket =====
    
    wireThemeSocket(socket);

    socket.on('connect', () => {
      console.log('Connected to server');
      socket.emit('user-setting');
      socket.emit('start-server')
      socket.on('lan-link', link =>{
        connStatus.innerText = ` http://${link}`
      })
      socket.emit('get-incoming-transfers');
      socket.on('qr-code', (data) => {
        const img = document.querySelector('#qrcodeWeb img');
        if (!img) return;
        if (typeof data === 'string') img.src = data;
        else if (data && data.dataUrl) img.src = data.dataUrl;
        else if (data && data.url) img.src = data.url;
      });
      if (Toast) Toast.success('Connected', 1800);
    });

    socket.on('disconnect', () => {
      if (Toast) Toast.warning('Disconnected from main System');
    });

    socket.on('file-changed', (data) => {
      if (data && data.path && /\.(html|css|js)$/i.test(data.path)) {
        location.reload();
      }
    }); 

    // Incoming transfer lifecycle from LAN / peer
    socket.on('incoming-transfer', (data) => {
      upsertTransfer(data);
      if (data && !data.silent && Toast) {
        const name = data.name || data.filename || 'File';
        Toast.info('Incoming: ' + name, 2500);
      }
    });

    socket.on('transfer-progress', (data) => {
      // data: { id, progress|percent, received?, total?, name? }
      upsertTransfer(data);
    });

    socket.on('transfer-complete', (data) => {
      const t = { ...data, progress: 100, status: 'Done' };
      upsertTransfer(t);
      if (Toast) {
        Toast.success((data && (data.name || data.filename)) || 'Transfer' + ' complete');
      }
      // Optional: remove after a short delay
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (data && (data.removeAfter !== false)) {
          // keep visible unless server sends transfer-remove
        }
      }, 0);
    });

    socket.on('transfer-error', (data) => {
      if (data) {
        upsertTransfer({ ...data, status: 'Failed' });
      }
      const msg = (data && (data.error || data.message)) || 'Transfer failed';
      if (Toast) Toast.error(msg);
    });

    socket.on('transfer-remove', (data) => removeTransfer(data));
    socket.on('transfer-cancelled', (data) => {
      removeTransfer(data);
      if (Toast)Ttoast.info('Transfer cancelled');
    });

    socket.on('incoming-transfers', (data) => {
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data && data.transfers) || [];
      renderTransfers(list);
    });

    // QR / connection helpers if server sends them
    socket.on('qr-code', (data) => {
      const img = document.querySelector('#qrcodeWeb img');
      if (!img) return;
      if (typeof data === 'string') img.src = data;
      else if (data && data.dataUrl) img.src = data.dataUrl;
      else if (data && data.url) img.src = data.url;
    });
    socket.on('lan-link', link =>{
        connStatus.textContent = link
    })

    socket.on('connection-status', (data) => {
      if (!data) return;
      connStatus.textContent = data.text || data.status || (data.connected ? 'Connected' : 'Not Connected');
    });
    socket.on('close-app', () =>{
      console.log('close app emite')
      xenderNative.close()
    })
    socket.on('flash', () =>{
      console.log('close app emite')
      xenderNative.flash()
    })
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    /**
     * Close the popover modal
     */
    function closePopover(event) {
      if (event) {
        event.stopPropagation();
      }
      popoverContainer.close();
    }
    
    /**
     * Display content in the popover
     * @param {string} content - HTML content to display
     */
    function showPopoverContent(content) {
      popoverContent.innerHTML = content;
      popoverContainer.showModal();
    }
    
    /**
     * Show theme selection popover
     */
    function showThemePop() {
      let themeHtml = `
      <h3>Theme</h3>
      <div class="btn">
        <button onclick="setTheme('light', true); closePopover();">Light</button>
        <button onclick="setTheme('dark', true); closePopover();">Dark</button>
      </div>`;
      showPopoverContent(themeHtml);
    }

              <input type="radio" name="accent" id="colored"><p> Colored</p>

    accentColorSetting.addEventListener('click', (e) =>{{
      showAccentPop()
    }})
    
    /**
     * Show app logs in popover
     */
    function showAppLogs() {
      showPopoverContent('<h3>App Logs</h3><p>Logs loading...</p>');
    }
    
    /**
     * ===== SCAN DIRECTORY MANAGEMENT =====
     */
    let currentScanDirs = [];
    let selectedDirIndex = -1;
    
    /**
     * Show scan directory management popover
     */
    function showScanDirPop() {
      let dirItemsHtml = '';
      
      if (currentScanDirs.length > 0) {
        dirItemsHtml = currentScanDirs.map((dir, index) => `
          <div class="scan-dir-item">
            <input 
              type="text" 
              class="scan-dir-input" 
              value="${dir}" 
              data-index="${index}"
              onclick="selectScanDir(${index})"
              onfocus="selectScanDir(${index})"
              onchange="updateScanDir(${index}, this.value)"
            />
            <button 
              class="scan-dir-remove-btn" 
              id="remove-btn-${index}"
              onclick="removeScanDir(${index})"
              ${index === selectedDirIndex ? '' : 'disabled'}
              title="Remove this directory"
            >
              <i class="fa fa-trash"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } else {
        dirItemsHtml = '<p style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 10px;">No directories added yet</p>';
      }
      
      let popoverHtml = `
        <h3>Scan Directories</h3>
        <div class="scan-dir-container">
          <div class="scan-dir-list">
            ${dirItemsHtml}
          </div>
          <input 
            type="text"
            inert
            class="scan-dir-new-input" 
            id="newDirInput"
            placeholder="Enter path to add new directory (e.g., C:\\Users\\Downloads)"
          />
          <button id="select-btn" onclick="openFolder()">Select</button>
          <div class="scan-dir-actions">
            <button class="scan-dir-add-btn" onclick="addScanDir()" title="Add new directory">

            </button>

    function openFolder() {
        const newInput = document.getElementById('newDirInput')
        const selectBtn = document.getElementById('select-btn')
        const addScandir = document.querySelector('select-btn')
        selectBtn.addEventListener('click', async (e) =>{
          const path = await xenderNative.selectFolder()
          if (path.ok) {
            newInput.value = path.data.path
            addScanDir.click()
            socket.emit('add-scan-dir', path.data.path)
          }
        })
        console.log(xenderNative)
        
    }
    /**
     * Select a scan directory (enable remove button)
     */
    function selectScanDir(index) {
      selectedDirIndex = index;
      
      // Update all remove buttons
      currentScanDirs.forEach((_, i) => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`remove-btn-${i}`);
        if (btn) {
          if (i === index) {
            btn.disabled = false;
          } else {
            btn.disabled = true;
          }
        }
      });
    }
    
    /**
     * Add a new scan directory
     */
    function addScanDir() {
      const newDirInput = document.getElementById('newDirInput');
      const newDir = newDirInput.value.trim();
      
      if (!newDir) {
        Toast.warning('Please enter a directory path');
        return;
      }
      
      if (currentScanDirs.includes(newDir)) {
        Toast.warning('This directory is already in the list');
        return;
      }
      
      currentScanDirs.push(newDir);
      selectedDirIndex = -1;
      
      // Emit to socket
      socket.emit('add-scan-dir', newDir);
      Toast.success('Directory added');
      
      // Refresh popover
      showScanDirPop();
    }
    
    /**
     * Update a scan directory path
     */
    function updateScanDir(index, newPath) {
      const oldPath = currentScanDirs[index];
      
      if (!newPath.trim()) {
        Toast.warning('Directory path cannot be empty');
        showScanDirPop();
        return;
      }
      
      if (newPath === oldPath) return;
      
      currentScanDirs[index] = newPath;
      socket.emit('remove-scan-dir', oldPath);
      socket.emit('add-scan-dir', newPath);
      Toast.success('Directory updated');
      updateScanDirPreview();
    }
    
    /**
     * Remove a scan directory
     */
    function removeScanDir(index) {
      const dirToRemove = currentScanDirs[index];
      currentScanDirs.splice(index, 1);
      selectedDirIndex = -1;
      
      // Emit to socket
      socket.emit('remove-scan-dir', dirToRemove);
      Toast.success('Directory removed');
      
      // Refresh popover
      if (currentScanDirs.length > 0) {
        showScanDirPop();
      } else {
        closePopover();
      }
      updateScanDirPreview();
    }
    
    /**
     * Update the preview text
     */
    function updateScanDirPreview() {
      const preview = document.getElementById('scanDirectoryPreview');
      if (preview) {
        const shortPaths = currentScanDirs.map(p => p.split('\\').pop()).join(', ');
        preview.textContent = shortPaths || 'No directories';
      }
    }

    function setAccent(accent, a=false) {
      const accents = {
        'primary': { src: 'style/theme.css', icon: 'icon/logo.png' },
        'colored': { src: 'style/theme-color.css', icon: 'icon/logo-color.png'  },
        'neon': { src: 'style/theme-dark.css', icon: 'icon/logo-dark.png'  },
      }
      const current = accentTag.href
      const found = accents[accent]
      const iconTag = document.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]')
      iconTag.href = found.icon
      if (found.src !== current) {
        accentColorText.innerText = accent
        accentTag.href = found.src
        if (a) {
          socket.emit('save-accent', accent)
        }
      }
    }
    setAccent('neon')

     * Check for application updates

      if (!navigator.onLine) {
        Toast.warning('You are  Offline, Connect and try again')
      }
      //showPopoverContent('<h3>Check for Update</h3><p>Checking for updates...</p>');
    }
    
    /**
     * Clear application cache

    function clearCache() {
      Toast.info('Clearing cache...');
      // Add cache clearing logic here

    }

    // ===== EVENT LISTENERS & INITIALIZATION =====
    const socketHandler = socket.on('connect', () => {

    socketHandler.on('version', version =>{

    downloadFolderSetting.addEventListener('click', async (e) =>{

    // Set initial theme value

      html.setAttribute('data-theme', newTheme);

class Includetml extends HTMLElement {
    //Shared cache for all instance
    static cache = new Map()
    static getobservedAttributes(){
        return ['src', 'loading', 'error'];
    }
    connectedCallback(){
        this.load()
    }
    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue){
        if (oldValue !== newValue && name === 'src') {
            this.load()
        }
    }
    getContent(type){
        //1 try slot first
        const slotContent = this.querySelector(`[slot="${type}"]`)
        if (slotContent) {
            return slotContent.innerHTML
        }
        //2 fall back to attribute
        const attrContent = this.getAttribute(type);
        if (attrContent) {
            return attrContent
        }
        //3 default
        if (type === 'loading') {
            return 'Loading...';
        }
        if (type === 'error') {
            return `<div style='color:red;'>Failed to load content</div>`;
        }
        return
    }
    async load() {
        const src = this.getAttribute('src')
        if (!src) return;
        
        //show loading state
        this.innerHTML = this.getContent('loading');

        try {
            let html

            //check cache first
            if (Includetml.cache.get(src)) {
                html = Includetml.cache.get('src');
            } else {
                const respond = await fetch(src);
                if (!respond.ok) {
                    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('include-html-error', {
                    detail: { error: `Error loading html from ${src}`, status: respond.status},
                    bubbles: true
                }))
                    throw new Error(`HTTP Error: ${respond.status}`)
                }
                html = await respond.text();

                //save to cache
                Includetml.cache.set(src, html)
            }
            this.innerHTML = html
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('include-html-loaded', {
                detail: {src},
                bubbles: true
            }))
        } catch (error) {
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('include-html-error', {
                detail: { error: `Error loading html from ${src}`, status: error.stack},
                bubbles: true
            }))
            console.error(error);
            this.innerHTML = this.getContent('error')
        }
    }
}
customElements.define('include-html', Includetml)
--- CONTENT END ---

/**
 * Shared theme & accent helpers for Xender-lite
 */
(function (global) {
  const ACCENTS = {
    primary: { src: '/style/theme.css', icon: '/icon/logo.png' },
    colored: { src: '/style/theme-color.css', icon: '/icon/logo-color.png' },
    neon: { src: '/style/theme-dark.css', icon: '/icon/logo-dark.png' },
  };

  function setTheme(newTheme) {
    document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', newTheme || 'dark');
  }

  function setAccent(accent) {
    const accentTag = document.getElementById('accent');
    if (!accentTag) return;
    const found = ACCENTS[accent] || ACCENTS.primary;
    const iconTag = document.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]');
    if (iconTag) iconTag.href = found.icon;
    if (accentTag.href.indexOf(found.src) === -1) {
      accentTag.href = found.src;
    }
  }

  function wireThemeSocket(socket) {
    if (!socket) return;
    socket.on('theme', setTheme);
    socket.on('accent', setAccent);
  }

  global.setTheme = setTheme;
  global.setAccent = setAccent;
  global.wireThemeSocket = wireThemeSocket;
})(window);
--- CONTENT END ---

// ============================================================
//  Xender-lite PWA-style Splash Screen  (single file)
// ============================================================
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- CONFIG ----------
  const CONFIG = {
    minDisplayTime: 1400,          // minimum time splash is shown (ms)
    fadeDuration: 550,             // fade-out duration (must match CSS)
    defaultTheme: "primary",

    // Logo paths for each theme
    logos: {
      primary:   "icon/logo.png",
      alternate: "icon/logo-color.png",
      light:     "icon/logo-light.png",
      dark:      "icon/logo-dark.png"
    }
  };

  // ---------- INJECT CSS ----------
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = `
    #xender-splash {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 99999;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: var(--bg);
      transition: opacity ${CONFIG.fadeDuration}ms ease,
                  visibility ${CONFIG.fadeDuration}ms ease;
    }

    #xender-splash.hide {
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    #xender-splash img {
      width: 220px;
      height: 220px;
      object-fit: contain;
      animation: xenderPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    #xender-splash .brand {
      margin-top: 18px;
      color: var(--text, #fff);
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
      opacity: 0.75;
    }

    @keyframes xenderPulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1);    opacity: 1; }
      50%      { transform: scale(1.07); opacity: 0.82; }
    }

    /* Hide real content until splash finishes */
    body.xender-loading > *:not(#xender-splash) {
      opacity: 0 !important;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    body.xender-ready > *:not(#xender-splash) {
      opacity: 1;
      transition: opacity 0.45s ease 0.1s;
    }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  // ---------- CREATE SPLASH ----------
  function createSplash() {
    const theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || CONFIG.defaultTheme;
    const logoSrc = CONFIG.logos[theme] || CONFIG.logos.primary;

    const splash = document.createElement("div");
    splash.id = "xender-splash";

    splash.innerHTML = `
      <img src="${logoSrc}" alt="Xender-lite" />
      <div class="brand">Xender-lite</div>
    `;

    document.body.prepend(splash);
    document.body.classList.add("xender-loading");

    return splash;
  }

  // ---------- HIDE SPLASH ----------
  function hideSplash(splash) {
    const start = performance.now();

    function finish() {
      const elapsed = performance.now() - start;
      const wait = Math.max(0, CONFIG.minDisplayTime - elapsed);

      setTimeout(() => {
        splash.classList.add("hide");
        document.body.classList.remove("xender-loading");
        document.body.classList.add("xender-ready");

        // Clean up after animation
        setTimeout(() => {
          splash.remove();
        }, CONFIG.fadeDuration + 40);
      }, wait);
    }

    if (document.readyState === "complete") {
      finish();
    } else {
      window.addEventListener("load", finish);
    }
  }

  // ---------- INIT ----------
  function init() {
    // Make sure body exists
    if (!document.body) {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
      return;
    }

    const splash = createSplash();
    hideSplash(splash);
  }

  // Start
  init();

  // Optional: expose a small helper if you want to change theme later
  window.XenderSplash = {
    setTheme(theme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
      const img = document.querySelector("#xender-splash img");
      if (img && CONFIG.logos[theme]) {
        img.src = CONFIG.logos[theme];
      }
    }
  };
})();

/**
 * Modern Toast Notification (Updated)
 * 
 * Simple usage:
 *   Toast.success('Saved successfully')
 *   Toast.error('Something went wrong', 4000)   // 4 seconds
 *   Toast.warning('Check your input', 5000)
 *   Toast.info('New update available')
 *
 * Full options still supported:
 *   Toast.error('Failed', { duration: 5000, position: 'bottom-center' })
 */

    if (containers[position]) return containers[position];

    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = `toast-container ${position}`;
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    containers[position] = el;
    return el;
  }

  function normalizeOptions(secondArg) {
    // Allow: Toast.error('msg', 4000)
    if (typeof secondArg === 'number') {
      return { duration: secondArg };
    }
    // Allow: Toast.error('msg', { duration: 4000, position: '...' })
    if (secondArg && typeof secondArg === 'object') {
      return secondArg;
    }
    return {};
  }

  function createToast(message, secondArg, forceType) {
    injectStyles();

    const userOptions = normalizeOptions(secondArg);
    const config = { ...DEFAULTS, ...userOptions };

    if (forceType) config.type = forceType;

    const type = config.type || 'info';
    const container = getContainer(config.position);

    // Limit max toasts
    while (container.children.length >= config.maxToasts) {
      const first = container.firstChild;
      if (first) first.remove();
    }

    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = `toast ${type}`;

    toast.innerHTML = `
      <div class="toast-content">
        <div class="toast-icon">${ICONS[type] || ICONS.info}</div>
        <div class="toast-message">${message}</div>
        <button class="toast-close" aria-label="Close">
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5">
            <path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12"/>
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
      ${config.showProgress && config.duration > 0 ? `<div class="toast-progress"></div>` : ''}
    `;

    container.appendChild(toast);

    const progressBar = toast.querySelector('.toast-progress');
    let remaining = config.duration;
    let startTime = Date.now();
    let timer = null;
    let paused = false;

    function hide() {
      toast.classList.add('hide');
      clearTimeout(timer);
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (toast.parentNode) toast.remove();
      }, 280);
    }

    function startTimer() {
      if (config.duration <= 0) return;

      if (progressBar) {
        progressBar.style.animationDuration = remaining + 'ms';
        progressBar.classList.add('running');
        progressBar.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
      }

      timer = setTimeout(hide, remaining);
    }

    // Close button
    toast.querySelector('.toast-close').addEventListener('click', hide);

    // Pause on hover
    if (config.pauseOnHover && config.duration > 0) {
      toast.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        if (paused) return;
        paused = true;
        clearTimeout(timer);
        remaining -= (Date.now() - startTime);
        if (remaining < 0) remaining = 0;
        if (progressBar) progressBar.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
      });

      toast.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        if (!paused) return;
        paused = false;
        startTime = Date.now();
        startTimer();
      });
    }

    startTimer();

    return { hide, el: toast };
  }

  // ====================== PUBLIC API ======================
  const Toast = {
    show(message, secondArg) {
      return createToast(message, secondArg);
    },
    success(message, secondArg) {
      return createToast(message, secondArg, 'success');
    },
    error(message, secondArg) {
      return createToast(message, secondArg, 'error');
    },
    warning(message, secondArg) {
      return createToast(message, secondArg, 'warning');
    },
    info(message, secondArg) {
      return createToast(message, secondArg, 'info');
    },

    // Change global defaults
    config(newConfig) {
      Object.assign(DEFAULTS, newConfig);
    }
  };

  window.Toast = Toast;

})(window);
--- CONTENT END ---

/**
 * Xender Lite — native host client
 * Works with the PowerShell WebView2 host (window.xenderNative bridge).
 *
 * Usage:
 *   import { native, onNativeEvent, isNativeHost } from './xender-native.js';
 *   // or <script src="xender-native.js"></script> → window.XenderNative
 */

(function (root, factory) {
  if (typeof module === "object" && module.exports) {
    module.exports = factory();
  } else if (typeof define === "function" && define.amd) {
    define([], factory);
  } else {
    root.XenderNative = factory();
  }
})(typeof self !== "undefined" ? self : this, function () {
  "use strict";

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Internal state
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  let transferCount = 0;
  const eventHandlers = new Map(); // eventName -> Set<fn>
  let closeHandler = null;
  let readyPromise = null;
  let readyResolve = null;
  let bridgeAttached = false;

  function ensureReadyDeferred() {
    if (!readyPromise) {
      readyPromise = new Promise(function (resolve) {
        readyResolve = resolve;
      });
    }
    return readyPromise;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Bridge access
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function getBridge() {
    return typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.xenderNative : null;
  }

  function isNativeHost() {
    const b = getBridge();
    return !!(b && b.__bridge);
  }

  /**
   * Wait until the host has injected the bridge and fired appReady
   * (or timeout). Resolves to true if native is available.
   */
  function whenReady(timeoutMs) {
    timeoutMs = timeoutMs == null ? 8000 : timeoutMs;
    if (isNativeHost() && bridgeAttached) {
      return Promise.resolve(true);
    }
    const p = ensureReadyDeferred();
    return Promise.race([
      p.then(function () {
        return isNativeHost();
      }),
      new Promise(function (resolve) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          resolve(isNativeHost());
        }, timeoutMs);
      }),
    ]);
  }

  function call(method, args) {
    const b = getBridge();
    if (!b || typeof b[method] !== "function") {
      return Promise.resolve({
        ok: false,
        error: "native_unavailable",
      });
    }
    try {
      const result = b[method].apply(b, args || []);
      return Promise.resolve(result);
    } catch (err) {
      return Promise.resolve({
        ok: false,
        error: "exception",
        detail: String(err && err.message ? err.message : err),
      });
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Public API (mirrors host methods)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const native = {
    // Pickers (paths only — save settings in Node)
    pickDownloadRoot: function () {
      return call("pickDownloadRoot");
    },
    selectFolder: function () {
      return call("selectFolder");
    },
    selectFiles: function (opts) {
      return call("selectFiles", [opts || {}]);
    },
    selectSavePath: function (opts) {
      return call("selectSavePath", [opts || {}]);
    },
    revealInExplorer: function (path) {
      return call("revealInExplorer", [path]);
    },

    // Native dialogs
    showInfo: function (opts) {
      return call("showInfo", [opts || {}]);
    },
    showWarning: function (opts) {
      return call("showWarning", [opts || {}]);
    },
    showError: function (opts) {
      return call("showError", [opts || {}]);
    },
    confirm: function (opts) {
      return call("confirm", [opts || {}]);
    },
    confirmYesNoCancel: function (opts) {
      return call("confirmYesNoCancel", [opts || {}]);
    },

    // Window chrome
    setTitle: function (title) {
      return call("setTitle", [title]);
    },
    setAlwaysOnTop: function (value) {
      return call("setAlwaysOnTop", [!!value]);
    },
    minimize: function () {
      return call("minimize");
    },
    maximize: function () {
      return call("maximize");
    },
    restore: function () {
      return call("restore");
    },
    close: function () {
      return call("close");
    },
    flash: function () {
      return call("flash");
    },
    setSize: function (width, height) {
      return call("setSize", [width, height]);
    },
    getSize: function () {
      return call("getSize");
    },
    setMinSize: function (width, height) {
      return call("setMinSize", [width, height]);
    },
    setMaxSize: function (width, height) {
      return call("setMaxSize", [width, height]);
    },
    setResizable: function (value) {
      return call("setResizable", [!!value]);
    },
    setPosition: function (x, y) {
      return call("setPosition", [x, y]);
    },
    center: function () {
      return call("center");
    },
    getBounds: function () {
      return call("getBounds");
    },
    getAppInfo: function () {
      return call("getAppInfo");
    },

    ackWindowClosing: function (payload) {
      const b = getBridge();
      if (b && typeof b.ackWindowClosing === "function") {
        b.ackWindowClosing(payload || { allow: true });
      }
    },
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Transfer tracking (for close confirm)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function setTransferInProgress(active) {
    if (active) transferCount += 1;
    else transferCount = Math.max(0, transferCount - 1);
  }

  function hasTransferInProgress() {
    return transferCount > 0;
  }

  function resetTransfers() {
    transferCount = 0;
  }

  /**
   * Optional custom close gate.
   * handler: async () => boolean  (true = allow close)
   * If set, runs instead of the default transfer check.
   */
  function setCloseHandler(handler) {
    closeHandler = typeof handler === "function" ? handler : null;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Events
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function onNativeEvent(eventName, fn) {
    if (typeof fn !== "function") return function () {};
    if (!eventHandlers.has(eventName)) eventHandlers.set(eventName, new Set());
    eventHandlers.get(eventName).add(fn);
    return function off() {
      const set = eventHandlers.get(eventName);
      if (set) set.delete(fn);
    };
  }

  function emitLocal(eventName, data) {
    const set = eventHandlers.get(eventName);
    if (!set) return;
    set.forEach(function (fn) {
      try {
        fn(data);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[XenderNative] event handler error:", err);
      }
    });
    const any = eventHandlers.get("*");
    if (any) {
      any.forEach(function (fn) {
        try {
          fn({ event: eventName, data: data });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("[XenderNative] event handler error:", err);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  async function handleWindowClosing() {
    try {
      let allow = true;

      if (closeHandler) {
        allow = !!(await closeHandler());
      } else if (hasTransferInProgress()) {
        const r = await native.confirm({
          title: "Transfer in progress",
          message:
            "A transfer is still running. Close Xender Lite anyway?\n\nUnfinished transfers will be stopped.",
          danger: true,
        });
        allow = !!(r && r.ok && r.data && r.data.confirmed);
      }

      native.ackWindowClosing({ allow: allow });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[XenderNative] windowClosing handler failed:", err);
      // Fail open so the window is not stuck
      native.ackWindowClosing({ allow: true });
    }
  }

  function onHostMessage(msg) {
    if (!msg || !msg.event) return;

    if (msg.event === "appReady") {
      bridgeAttached = true;
      if (readyResolve) {
        readyResolve(true);
        readyResolve = null;
      }
    }

    if (msg.event === "windowClosing") {
      handleWindowClosing();
    }

    emitLocal(msg.event, msg.data);
  }

  function attachToBridge() {
    const b = getBridge();
    if (b) {
      b.onEvent = onHostMessage;
      bridgeAttached = true;
    }

    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.addEventListener("xender-event", function (e) {
        const detail = e && e.detail;
        if (detail) onHostMessage(detail);
      });
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Helpers for common UI flows
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * Pick download root and optionally persist via your callback.
   * saveFn(path) should write to Node/settings — host does not save.
   */
  async function chooseDownloadRoot(saveFn) {
    const r = await native.pickDownloadRoot();
    if (!r.ok) return r;
    if (typeof saveFn === "function") {
      try {
        await saveFn(r.data.path);
      } catch (err) {
        return { ok: false, error: "save_failed", detail: String(err) };
      }
    }
    return r;
  }

  async function chooseFilesToSend(opts) {
    return native.selectFiles(
      opts || {
        multiple: true,
        filters: "All files (*.*)|*.*",
      }
    );
  }

  async function updateTitleFromTransfers() {
    if (!hasTransferInProgress()) {
      await native.setTitle("Xender Lite");
      return;
    }
    const n = transferCount;
    const label = n === 1 ? "1 transfer" : n + " transfers";
    await native.setTitle("Xender Lite — " + label);
  }

  async function notifyTransferDone() {
    await native.flash();
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Boot
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ensureReadyDeferred();
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", attachToBridge);
    } else {
      attachToBridge();
    }
    // Host may inject bridge slightly later
    setTimeout(attachToBridge, 0);
    setTimeout(attachToBridge, 200);
    setTimeout(attachToBridge, 1000);
  }

  return {
    native: native,
    isNativeHost: isNativeHost,
    whenReady: whenReady,
    onNativeEvent: onNativeEvent,

    setTransferInProgress: setTransferInProgress,
    hasTransferInProgress: hasTransferInProgress,
    resetTransfers: resetTransfers,
    setCloseHandler: setCloseHandler,

    chooseDownloadRoot: chooseDownloadRoot,
    chooseFilesToSend: chooseFilesToSend,
    updateTitleFromTransfers: updateTitleFromTransfers,
    notifyTransferDone: notifyTransferDone,
  };
});

/**
 * Example wiring for a Xender Lite web UI (browser / WebView2).
 * Assumes xender-native.js is loaded first.
 *
 * <script src="/xender-native.js"></script>
 * <script src="/xender-native-example.js"></script>
 */

(async function () {
  const api = window.XenderNative;
  if (!api) {
    console.warn("XenderNative not loaded");
    return;
  }

  const {
    native,
    whenReady,
    isNativeHost,
    onNativeEvent,
    setTransferInProgress, 
    chooseDownloadRoot,
    chooseFilesToSend,
    updateTitleFromTransfers,
    notifyTransferDone,
  } = api;

  const ready = await whenReady(5000);
  console.log("[Xender] native host:", isNativeHost(), "ready:", ready);

  if (!isNativeHost()) {
    // Running in a normal browser — hide native-only buttons, use <input type="file"> etc.
    return;
  }

  // Window chrome defaults
  await native.setMinSize(800, 500);
  await native.setTitle("Xender Lite");

  // --- Events ---
  onNativeEvent("windowResized", function (data) {
    console.log("resized", data);
  });

  onNativeEvent("windowMinimized", function () {
    console.log("minimized");
  });

  onNativeEvent("windowFocused", function () {
    console.log("focused");
  });

  onNativeEvent("appReady", function (data) {
    console.log("appReady", data);
  });

  // windowClosing is handled inside xender-native.js using transfer count.
  // Override if you need custom logic:
  // api.setCloseHandler(async () => {
  //   const r = await native.confirm({ title: "Quit?", message: "Leave now?", danger: true });
  //   return r.ok && r.data.confirmed;
  // });

  // --- Example: wire UI buttons (ids optional) ---
  function $(id) {
    return document.getElementById(id);
  }

  const btnDownloadRoot = $("btn-download-root");
  if (btnDownloadRoot) {
    btnDownloadRoot.addEventListener("click", async function () {
      const r = await chooseDownloadRoot(async function (path) {
        // Persist in YOUR Node settings — host does not save
        await fetch("/api/settings/download-root", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ path: path }),
        });
      });
      if (r.ok) {
        const el = $("download-root-label");
        if (el) el.textContent = r.data.path;
      }
    });
  }

  const btnSendFiles = $("btn-send-files");
  if (btnSendFiles) {
    btnSendFiles.addEventListener("click", async function () {
      const r = await chooseFilesToSend({
        multiple: true,
        filters: "All files (*.*)|*.*|Images|*.png;*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.gif|Videos|*.mp4;*.mkv",
      });
      if (!r.ok) return; // cancelled

      // Start a transfer (your app logic)
      setTransferInProgress(true);
      await updateTitleFromTransfers();

      try {
        await fetch("/api/transfer/send", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ files: r.data.files }),
        });
        await notifyTransferDone();
        await native.showInfo({
          title: "Xender Lite",
          message: "Transfer finished.",
        });
      } catch (err) {
        await native.showError({
          title: "Transfer failed",
          message: String(err && err.message ? err.message : err),
        });
      } finally {
        setTransferInProgress(false);
        await updateTitleFromTransfers();
      }
    });
  }

  const btnReveal = $("btn-reveal");
  if (btnReveal) {
    btnReveal.addEventListener("click", async function () {
      const path = ($("download-root-label") || {}).textContent;
      if (path) await native.revealInExplorer(path);
    });
  }

  const btnClose = $("btn-close");
  if (btnClose) {
    btnClose.addEventListener("click", function () {
      native.close(); // goes through windowClosing handshake
    });
  }
})();
